description: One feature of Develop's sprint (F216, the approved script's 4.4–4.6), run by Develop's loop as a side trip and kept in .bmuz/feature-runs/: the progress line → built by a fresh builder helper (every rule a test; proven by a script that runs them) → reviewed by a separate read-only reviewer, the confirmed findings fixed once (proven again) → ready for you to check → Play & Approve (nothing is done without your OK; an auto run leaves it as a question) → Tune & Revise (one setting, or the rule back to the rulebook) → recorded and committed
